predictionTexts.t1: Theorem G.6 is exact on network Hessians: in every operator cell (P = 33: beta in {0, 0.9} and every tether; P = 3,610: beta = 0.9, g = 2) the spectral radius of the exact second-moment operator T is below 1 at (1 - 1e-3) eta* and above 1 at (1 + 1e-3) eta*, with eta* = 1 / lambda_max(L_0^{-1/2} B_beta L_0^{-1/2}) by Lanczos.
predictionTexts.t2: The mean Hessian of the P = 3,610 network is indefinite: the smallest eigenvalue of its full eigendecomposition is negative (the shifted power iteration of Phase 10 gave only the upper bound 0.012; the Gauss-Newton part has rank at most 640 and the residual part of the squared loss is indefinite on its null space).
predictionTexts.t3: Mean-square stability implies almost-sure stability: in every cell the median sample-path ceiling of the linearised iteration is at least (1 - 0.02) eta* minus the largest bisection half-width.
predictionTexts.t4: Linearisation: in every cell the median sample-path ceiling of the network iteration (start 1e-6 from the checkpoint) is within 2 % plus the two largest bisection half-widths of the median ceiling of the linearised iteration.
predictionTexts.t5: Flat-mode collapse at P = 3,610: eta* decreases from g = 1/32 to g = 1/128, and the log-log slope of eta* against the smallest tethered eigenvalue between these two grid values lies in [0.4, 1.1] (the flat-mode bounds of Theorem G.5 give O(m) when the T_flat bound applies and O(sqrt(m)) from the pairwise bound otherwise; the interval allows for a grid that is not yet asymptotic).
predictionTexts.t6: The fraction f* = eta* (lambda_1 + mu) / (2 (1 + beta)) of the deterministic threshold is non-decreasing in mu along the grid, on both networks and for every beta (at fixed f every weight of the Rayleigh quotient of Theorem G.6(2) grows with mu and the numerator does not depend on mu). eta* itself need not be monotone; its interior maxima are reported, not predicted.

implementationCheckTexts.c1: For consecutive grid values mu1 < mu2 with eta*(mu1) <= eta_det(mu2) / 2, eta*(mu2) >= eta*(mu1) (below half the deterministic threshold every weight of Theorem G.6(2) grows with mu at fixed eta).
implementationCheckTexts.c3: Every operator cell left undecided by its certificates at 1e-3 is decided at the fallback offset 1e-2 (rule fixed before the P = 3,610 run).
implementationCheckTexts.c2: Every operator cell is decided by Collatz-Wielandt certificates at the last iterate: Q - T(Q) > 0 at (1 - 1e-3) eta* and T(Q) - Q > 0 at (1 + 1e-3) eta* (P = 33: from the full bracket [lambda_min, lambda_max] of Q^{-1/2} T(Q) Q^{-1/2}; P = 3,610: by Cholesky).
